MCQs: Handouts + preparation videos. XML and CSS3 topics included.
Short Questions:
1. Syntax of do-while loop.
2. Syntax of JQuery.
3. Traversing DOM in JQuery (Traversing Up - Short).
4. Transparency at 50% code.
Long Questions:
1. Canvas properties and methods (Scenario based).
2. Traversing sideways (<li> scenario, JQuery code).
3. JQuery traversing topics (Up, Down, Sideways) are very important.

These topics repeat frequently in recent CS202 Final Term exams (based on student-shared resources): 

* HTML Basics: tags, lists, tables, forms, audio/video, iframe
* CSS Essentials: selectors, box model, floats, positioning, colors
* Responsive Design: media queries, grid layouts, flexbox
* JavaScript Fundamentals: variables, events, functions, loops, arrays
* DOM Manipulation & Events in JS & jQuery
* jQuery Methods: selectors, chaining, traversing, animate(), fadeIn(), HTML/CSS methods
* AJAX & XML/JSON: Introduction, syntax, sending/receiving requests
* HTML5 APIs: Canvas, local storage, audio/video, drag‑drop
* JSON vs XML & Namespaces
* RWD & media query usage
* CSS transitions, animations, shadows
* Gradient types, selectors…
